title: Bug
description: Bug tracking for the prefetch-compression fork. Filed during verification of the first live prefetch run (2026-09-28, session 20260927_142133_c789bd).

title: Prefetch adoption at the pre-API gate dispatches the stale pre-adoption request (full-price call after splice)
description:
Found while verifying the first live prefetch run (session 20260927_142133_c789bd, 2026-09-28).

EVIDENCE
- 17:06:19.203 prefetch armed at ~607,699 tokens (threshold 650,000, margin 0.05, window 1M).
- Worker ran in the background; the loop kept working (API calls #68-#83 executed during the worker window).
- 17:24:08.439 "Prefetch compaction adopted: 590 -> 77 messages, 35 live suffix rows kept".
- 17:24:35.223 API call #84: in=626,967, cache=16,384/626,967 (3%) -- the FULL pre-adoption transcript, dispatched ~16ms after the adoption.
- 17:25:23.986 API call #85: in=94,766 -- the first request that used the spliced list.

ROOT CAUSE
Loop order per iteration (agent/conversation_loop.py:1554-1556):
  prepare_iteration -> assemble_api_request -> run_preflight_gate -> ... -> dispatch
The pre-API gate's "adopted" branch (agent/turn_preflight.py:102-107) splices v.messages and then, with _prefetch_skip_blocking=True, falls through to _done("fallthrough") (line 242). The request was already assembled from the PRE-splice messages, so that stale assembly -- not the spliced list -- is what gets dispatched. The blocking-compression branch right below (lines 176-208) does it correctly: refund the api call and return _done("continue") so the loop re-assembles and re-measures before dispatch.

IMPACT
- One extra full-price request at the pre-adoption size (627K tokens, 3% cache).
- Its provider usage is recorded as last_prompt_tokens, leaving the compressor's "last real usage" anchored to a pre-adoption reading -> downstream spurious re-arm (see the ballot bug filed next to this one).

FIX DIRECTION
In the adopted branch, mirror the blocking branch: refund the api call and return _done("continue") (re-assemble + re-measure with the spliced list). Regression test: adoption at the pre-API gate must force a re-assembly before the next dispatch and must never dispatch the stale assembly.

title: Prefetch ballot re-arms on a stale post-adoption estimate (spurious second worker)
description:
Same live run (session 20260927_142133_c789bd, 2026-09-28); downstream of the stale-dispatch bug filed next to this one.

EVIDENCE
- 17:24:54.665 "Prefetch compression armed at ~627,679 tokens" -- a SECOND worker -- while the live context was ~95K (next request #85 in=94,766).
- The figure 627,679 == usage of the stale request #84 (626,967) + delta. The live message list (79 rows) was already the spliced compacted one.
- The second worker summarized the already-compacted list (summary prompt 44,119 chars), completed 17:28:51, adopted 17:29:00 ("79 -> 84 messages, 34 live suffix rows kept"). Harmless but wasteful; it emits another arm/announce/heartbeat cycle.

ROOT CAUSE
The prefetch step runs at the TOP of each gate (agent/turn_preflight.py:95-100 and 318-322; agent/turn_context_compaction.py:280-298; agent/turn_overflow.py:165; agent/turn_recovery.py:1786) before the gate's own deferral logic. can_prefetch / run_prefetch_compaction_step (agent/turn_prefetch_compaction.py:75-118, 319+) use the gate's pressure figure as-is. Immediately after a compaction commit/adoption that figure still falls back to last_prompt_tokens -- a pre-compaction real reading (usage_anchor fails closed on the splice -> anchored is None -> last_prompt_tokens stays 626,967). That stale figure lands INSIDE the prefetch band [threshold - margin*window, threshold) = [600K, 650K) BY CONSTRUCTION, so the ballot re-arms. The blocking branches avoid this via awaiting_real_usage_after_compression / should_defer_preflight_to_real_usage (agent/context_compressor.py:2804-2821), which the prefetch step does not consult.

FIX DIRECTION
Make the prefetch step honor the same "wait one real reading after a compression" deferral: skip arming while _compressor.awaiting_real_usage_after_compression (or when the figure is not a post-commit real reading). Note: fixing the stale-dispatch bug is necessary but NOT sufficient -- one gate pass still runs between adoption and the next real reading, and the stale figure lands in the band.

title: Prefetch worker emits blocking-mode status lines ('summarizing earlier conversation so I can continue')
description:
User-visible symptom (2026-09-28, session 20260927_142133_c789bd): right after the "(prefetch)" arm line the chat showed the BLOCKING-mode texts, which read as the agent pausing to compress:
  1. "Compacting context -- summarizing earlier conversation so I can continue..."  (+63ms after arm)
  2. "Compacting context -- still summarizing earlier conversation so I can continue..."  (then recurring ~every 60s)

ROOT CAUSE
The prefetch worker runs the full compress_context pipeline on a pool thread. That pipeline announces itself to the client unconditionally:
- agent/conversation_compression.py:4073 -> 3998-4014 _announce_compression_start emits COMPACTION_STATUS (line 66) -- the same text as the blocking path.
- agent/conversation_compression.py:3885 starts _CompressionActivityHeartbeat with emit_client_status=lease.status_emitted (True because the start status was emitted) -> _emit_progress_status emits COMPACTION_HEARTBEAT_STATUS (line 69) every ~60s (line 1825 default 60s) while the worker runs.
The loop is NOT blocked (verified live: API calls #68-#83 ran during the worker window), but the wording is the blocking register. Gateway chat surfaces suppress these lines; CLI/desktop show them.

FIX DIRECTION
Suppress the worker's client-status emissions, or reword them for the prefetch context (keep "(prefetch)"/"in the background" wording on the announce + heartbeat when the emitter is the background worker). The prefetch-specific templates (PREFETCH_COMPACTION_*) already exist in the same module. Repro: any arm in a long-running session.
